title: The AI Tool That Replaced My Entire Marketing Team
angle: A founder reveals the exact AI stack that eliminated 6 marketing salaries overnight — not to brag, but because the math is terrifying and you need to see it

scenes.voiceover: I fired my entire marketing team last month. Six people. And revenue went UP.
scenes.visual_description: Founder stares dead into lens, deadpan face, sparse home office background. Hard cut zoom at word 'UP'.
scenes.caption_overlay: I FIRED MY ENTIRE MARKETING TEAM 👀

scenes.voiceover: Copywriter. SEO lead. Paid ads manager. Social strategist. Designer. $340K a year. Gone.
scenes.visual_description: Job titles flash on screen one by one in red, each with a salary figure. Final frame: $340,000 crossed out in bold.

scenes.voiceover: One AI stack. Four tools. Handles briefs, copy, visuals, ads, analytics, and posting. Watch.
scenes.visual_description: Fast screen capture showing dashboard switching between 4 tools: copy gen, image gen, ad manager, analytics. Speed-ramped with cursor highlights.

scenes.voiceover: Month one after: leads up 22%. Ad spend down 60%. Content output tripled. I'm not joking.
scenes.visual_description: Split-screen analytics graphs animating upward on left, dollar signs dropping on right. Real dashboard numbers flash in close-up.

scenes.voiceover: And here's the part nobody talks about — the team knew it was coming. They built the system themselves.
scenes.visual_description: Founder leans in closer to camera, lowered voice tone, slight pause before reveal. Lighting dims subtly to match confessional mood.

scenes.voiceover: So the real question isn't whether AI replaces your team. It's whether YOUR team survives what mine did.
scenes.visual_description: White text on black: 'Does YOUR team know what's coming?' Slow zoom in. Final frame mirrors opening shot of founder's face.
scenes.caption_overlay: Would YOUR team do the same? 👆 Watch again

hook_test.format_reference: Wait, what? — Hook with surprising claim → proof → bigger reveal
hook_test.viral_proof: Videos opening with a counter-intuitive business confession ('I shut down X and made more money') routinely hit 10M-40M views on TikTok. Reference: @hrishikesh_hirway-style founder confessionals and the 'I fired my team' genre that peaked in 2023 with multiple creators exceeding 15M views using identical emotional structure.
hook_test.why_it_works: The opening claim creates immediate cognitive dissonance — firing people but growing revenue violates expectation. Viewers must resolve the contradiction, forcing watch-through. The ethical twist in scene 5 adds moral complexity that drives comments and shares, boosting algorithmic distribution beyond the initial hook.
